title: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models for Load Forecasting Under Covariate Uncertainty
claim: On three hourly load datasets, Chronos-2 is the most accurate of eight models when future covariates are available or well forecast, and loses ground to a trained model as the covariate forecasts get noisier.
why_relevant: Hourly electric load with known-future covariates of varying quality, which is the oracle-versus-forecast weather question; horizon reported by search as day-ahead, not a week.
